sourceLimitations: Tests ran against a dirty integrated worktree rooted at the stated commit, through Vite actual source and an isolated local Worker. Per-file hashes identify the tested worktree; this is not exact-commit deployed CI or live Cloudflare/vendor proof. Only frontend files unchanged across the recorded interval may be treated as frozen during browser QA.
credentialReadinessLimit: All three Send task controls were disabled in repository drafts with no selected repository. This is not isolated proof of the credential gate. Actual read-only setup diagnostics and provider registry establish missing credentials; task preflight, inference, quota and external actions were deliberately not invoked.
liveBlockers: No real model credentials or provider accounts in isolated environment; no model/CLI execution tested.
No OpenConnector configured: provider catalog and connections return503.
Optional local paired-computer and extension connector/MCP endpoints return404 with those deployment features disabled.
Cloudflare hosted deployment, Slack delivery/approvals, real MCP OAuth/tool discovery and live native app side effects require separately authorized/configured integration testing.
